title: OTHRYS OS canonical mission trail
goal: Drive the OS Recent Missions surface from canonical mission result files so visible completion state does not depend on incomplete chat/GPT_STATE history.
laws: missions/*.result.json is the completion evidence source for this surface.
A mission without a result file must never be displayed as completed by inference.
Verdicts and candidate SHAs must be shown without rewriting historical evidence.
Mission titles may be joined from matching mission envelopes when present.
The trail is read-only and must tolerate malformed/unrelated files by omission.
Conversational summaries and GPT_STATE mission_history may supplement but never override result evidence.
No new write, routing, shell, provider, execution, accept, reject, release, Hephaestus, Talos or Worker authority.
